title: Dasatinib Combination Therapy With the Smoothened (SMO) Inhibitor BMS-833923 in Chronic Myeloid Leukemia (CML)

sections.abstract:
The purpose of the study is to determine the safety and tolerability of the combination of BMS-833923 plus dasatinib in patients with chronic myeloid leukemia.

Posted outcomes: Recommended Phase 2 Dose (RP2D) of BMS-833923 Plus Dasatinib in Chronic Myeloid Leukemia-Chronic Phase. timeframe=Day 1 to Week 80, with observation for DLT in Weeks 5-8. Dasatinib, 100/140 mg QD, Plus BMS-833923, 50-200 BID/QD=50
